title: SG-LegalClarify: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Legal Reasoning and Ambiguity Recognition in Singapore Law
abstract: arXiv:2611.19643v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Singapore offers a distinctive testbed for legal reasoning by large language models (LLMs). Its legal system combines inherited English common law with jurisdiction-specific statutes, requiring models to distinguish local doctrine from generic common-law intuition. This setting also highlights the challenge of recognizing underspecification in lay legal queries, because the facts material to a legal outcome depend on the governing doctrine. Yet legal benchmarks rarely cover Singapore law or test this form of ambiguity recognition. To address these gaps, we introduce SG-LegalClarify, a large-scale benchmark for open-ended legal reasoning and ambiguity recognition in Singapore law. SG-LegalClarify contains 1,100 lawyer-authored source questions spanning 10 legal domains, including 340 fully specified and 760 underspecified questions. translated_title: SG-LegalClarify：一个面向新加坡法律的法律推理与歧义识别大规模基准
translated_abstract: 新加坡为大语言模型（LLM）的法律推理提供了一个独特的试验场。其法律体系融合了继承自英国的普通法与本地特有的成文法，要求模型能够区分本地法理与一般性的普通法直觉。这一背景还凸显了识别非专业用户法律查询中信息不完整问题的挑战，因为对法律结果至关重要的案件事实取决于所适用的法理。然而，现有的法律基准很少涵盖新加坡法律，也很少测试这种歧义识别能力。为弥补这些空白，我们推出了 SG-LegalClarify，一个面向新加坡法律开放式法律推理与歧义识别的大规模基准。SG-LegalClarify 包含 1,100 个由律师撰写的源问题，涵盖 10 个法律领域，其中包括 340 个信息完全明确的问题和 760 个信息不完整的问题。每个信息不完整的问题都有固定的隐藏事实设定以及一个信息完全明确的对应版本……
tldr: 该论文提出了SG-LegalClarify——首个针对新加坡法律的大规模基准，包含1,100个律师撰写的问题，用于评估大语言模型在开放式法律推理中区分本地法理与普通法直觉以及识别非专业法律查询中信息缺失的能力。
en_tdlr: Introduces SG-LegalClarify, a large-scale benchmark of 1,100 lawyer-authored questions spanning 10 legal domains that evaluates LLMs' open-ended legal reasoning and their ability to recognize underspecification in lay legal queries under Singapore law.
